overviewParagraph: The Golden Designs Bergen 6 Person Outdoor Traditional Sauna offers a luxurious retreat in your own backyard, designed to accommodate up to six people comfortably. Crafted with an espresso all-weather exterior and a Canadian Red Cedar interior, this sauna combines durability with elegance. The 8.0 kW stove and advanced chromotherapy lighting system, featuring red light therapy, provide a rejuvenating experience that promotes muscle relaxation, stress relief, and improved circulation. With built-in Bluetooth connectivity and performance speakers, you can enjoy your favorite music while unwinding. Ideal for outdoor settings, this sauna is a perfect addition to enhance your wellness routine.

Product Ad-Copy: With a Golden Designs all-weather exterior outdoor traditional sauna, you can turn that dream of your very own home spa into a reality. Even where space is at a premium, you can still enjoy the good life in the form of a delightfully relaxing and invigorating steam sauna in the comfort of your own home.
Our Modern Series brings even more relaxation with an all-natural Canadian Red Cedar interior finish, providing an invigorating rich aroma to your sauna session.
Golden Designs traditional saunas provide a healthier way to live. Enjoy the wealth of health benefits a traditional sauna brings to your life. Take the first step to a healthier life!
